body: # Allspring Small Company Growth Fund Q1 2026 Commentary. May 27, 2026, 11:50 AM ETAllspring Small Company Growth Fd;Inst (WSCGX), WFSAX, WSCRX. * Allspring Small Company Growth Fund generated a total return of -4.91% for the quarter, underperforming the -2.81% return of the Russell 2000 Growth Index. * For the three-month period, information technology, industrials, and materials were the largest contributors to performance. * Health care, financials, and consumer staples were the largest detractors from performance in the quarter. Allspring is a company committed to thoughtful investing, purposeful planning, and the desire to elevate investing to be worth more. Allspring is reimagining investment management to be worth more—creating an investment, distribution, and operational experience that changes the game for clients. Note: This account is not managed or monitored by Allspring, and any messages sent via Seeking Alpha will not receive a response. Funds in this domestic category are generally expected to have at least 75% of their assets in US securities. Performance Returns 1,2 as of 04/30/2026. YTD. 3

Allspring Asset Allocation Fund GENERAL FUND INFORMATION Ticker: EAAIX Portfolio managers: Petros Bocray, CFA®, FRM; David Kowalske, Jr.; and Randy Rennicke, CFA® Subadvisor: Allspring Global Investments, LLC Category: Moderate allocation FUND STRATEGY ●Invests in affiliated mutual funds that collectively provide diversified exposure across and within a range of asset classes and subasset classes ●Determines strategic weights of portfolio allocations based on portfolio management team's research that produces capital market assumptions used in combination with risk assessments and correlations ●Employs a Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) Overlay strategy that combines quantitative models and qualitative judgments and uses futures contracts and other instruments to implement portfolio tilts toward assets with higher expected returns or lower expected risk Quarterly review ●The fund underperformed its custom benchmark, a blend of the Russell 3000 Index (45%), the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index (Net) (20%), and the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index (35%), during the quarter.
